name: curvature-calculation-mode-extension-index-0
reference: Values chosen; encoded as the PDU type CAM of the ASN.1 module CAM-PDU-Descriptions (ETSI EN 302 637-2 v1.4.1, forge.etsi.org cam_en302637_2 commit fed28cfe5c930dd9d3109ff1162c28008697754a) with ITS-Container (TS 102 894-2 v1.3.1, commit 2d2450e79aab4c7032ef615b72ddefaf2e5ba8a9) by two independent UPER codecs that agree byte for byte: asn1tools 0.169.0 (MIT, PyPI), codec uper, and pycrate 0.8.1 (LGPL, PyPI), to_uper. Vector 01 with curvatureCalculationMode in the extension form: bit 1, then the normally small non-negative whole number 0 (0 and 000000), in place of the root form (bit 0 and the index in 2 bits). ENUMERATED with three root values, so the extension index 0 decodes as 3 + 0 = 3 (0.19, enum:<n>:ext) and re-encodes in the extension form. v1.4.1 defines no extension value; the bytes were built by hand from vector 01 and are the bytes both codecs write for a copy of ITS-Container whose CurvatureCalculationMode has one extension value extMode3(3). 327 bits, padded to 41 octets. Checked against the pack's lines by a standalone reader and writer of them (Python standard library); derived without an engine.
